skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — share this video with my editor so they can open and continue editing it —...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of editor-link

- Upload video files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) for collaborative editing link creation.
- Automatic setup: cloud session and token are managed for you; get notified when ready.
- Instantly generate shareable editor links so collaborators can continue editing your project.
- Integrated cloud render pipeline: exports 1080p MP4s in under 90 seconds.
- Supports checking credits, uploading files, tracking status, and exporting final videos via direct user commands.
- Detailed session management and error handling for a seamless handoff from creator to editor.
